detail: Wake 4 hand-wrote ledger records without a timestamp. The records are genuine and hash-valid, but the reader required the field, so the ledger refused to parse them and wakes 5 and 6 aborted at preflight. Cause is the harness offering no validated way to append: every decision record so far was hand-written. Fixed by treating an incomplete-but-valid record as a recorded defect, by verifying records as written rather than as reconstructed, and by giving the agent the harness's own append code as secre-record.
